# Detail.vue Registered Unused Component Bug
In 苏州市房地产监测V3 project, companyAdmin/detail.vue registered RegisterUploadItem in components but did not import it and template unused, causing reference error.

## Root Cause
- companyAdmin/detail.vue components registered RegisterUploadItem without import
- Template did not use the component, redundant registration caused reference error

## Fix
- Deleted redundant registration of RegisterUploadItem
- Essential upload routed through AppendixPackageSection to restore routing

# Export Button Loading Pattern
Reusable technique that binds a loading flag to export buttons so duplicate clicks are blocked, applied in both Yixing Public Revenue and Huaian Property Management admin projects.

## Implementation
- Add an `exportLoading` field and bind it to the button's `loading` (or `attrs.loading`) attribute.
- Set `exportLoading` to `true` when the export request starts and reset it to `false` in `finally`.
- The loading state intercepts duplicate submissions.

## Yixing Attribution
- Verified src=宜兴公共收益/002.md; baseline none; session 0ed8887c-bd1f-4c05-a0c0-05c9ac915e28.
- Files: zhi2-web-admin/src/views/property/complex/index.vue, property/relocationSurvey/index.vue, building/building/index.vue, property/partSpot/index.vue, publicQuery/complex/index.vue, api/index.js, mixins/listMixins.js, property/extract/index.vue.

## Huaian Attribution
- Verified src=淮安物管/005.md; baseline none; session 968e6aef-a864-48b6-8689-93f6af2352ef.
- Huaian export previously lacked a Loading state, inconsistent with `building/unit` and `credit/record` list pages; an `exportLoading` variable was bound to the button `loading` attribute and reset in `download`'s `finally`.
- Files: zhi2-web-admin/src/views/benefit/pubAccountBalance/index.vue, property/propertyAccount/index.vue, evaluation/evaluation/quarter/index.vue, property/census/index.vue, api/index.js, mixins/listMixins.js, mixins/table.js, mixins/ListTemplate.js.

# 导出按钮 Loading 防重复点击模式
在宜兴公共收益与淮安物管后台项目中复用的一项技术：将 loading 标志绑定到导出按钮，阻止重复点击。

## 实现方式
- 新增 `exportLoading` 字段并绑定到按钮的 `loading`（或 `attrs.loading`）属性。
- 导出请求发起时置 `exportLoading` 为 `true`，在 `finally` 中重置为 `false`。
- loading 状态拦截重复提交。
